stories.headline: Broadcom AI chip revenue doubles to $8.4B in Q1, projects over $100B by 2027

key_facts.fact: Broadcom reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $19.31 billion, up 29% year-over-year, with AI semiconductor revenue reaching $8.4 billion, surging 106% YoY
key_facts.excerpt: AI revenue jumps 106% to $8.4 billion in first quarter... First-quarter revenue rises 29% to $19.31 billion

key_facts.fact: CEO Hock Tan projected AI chip revenue will be 'significantly in excess of $100 billion' by 2027, referring specifically to silicon content including custom XPUs and switching chips
key_facts.excerpt: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan sees the artificial intelligence boom gaining so much steam that he's projecting AI chip revenue next year 'significantly in excess of $100 billion'

key_facts.fact: Broadcom expanded to six AI chip customers, with OpenAI as the newest partner expected to ship over one gigawatt of compute capacity in 2027
key_facts.excerpt: Expects OpenAI partnership to ship over one gigawatt of compute capacity in 2027

key_facts.fact: Broadcom announced a new $10 billion share buyback program and guided Q2 revenue to approximately $22.0 billion, up 47% year-over-year
key_facts.excerpt: New $10 billion share repurchase program... Second quarter fiscal year 2026 revenue guidance of approximately $22.0 billion, an increase of 47 percent from the prior year period

key_facts.fact: Shares surged approximately 7% in premarket trading on March 5 following the earnings report
key_facts.excerpt: Broadcom shares surged approximately 7% in premarket trading on Thursday, March 5, 2026

stories.headline: Marvell posts record $8.2B annual revenue on AI demand, forecasts 30%+ growth in FY2027

key_facts.fact: Marvell reported record fiscal 2026 revenue of $8.195 billion, up 42% year-over-year, with Q4 revenue of $2.219 billion rising 22% YoY
key_facts.excerpt: Net revenue for fiscal 2026 was $8.195 billion, a new record... Net revenue for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 was $2.219 billion

key_facts.fact: Data center revenue made up 74% of total revenue at a record $1.65 billion in Q4, with custom silicon revenue already at approximately $1.5 billion and expected to grow over 20% in FY2027
key_facts.excerpt: Data center made up 74% of revenue with a record $1.65 billion... custom silicon (already ~$1.5B) is expected to grow >20% in FY2027

key_facts.fact: Management raised fiscal 2027 revenue guidance to grow over 30%, approaching $11 billion, with Q1 guidance of $2.4 billion beating the $2.28 billion consensus
key_facts.excerpt: For the current quarter, Marvell forecast adjusted earnings of 79 cents per share on sales of $2.4 billion. Wall Street had been modeling earnings of 74 cents per share on sales of $2.28 billion

key_facts.fact: Marvell introduced 1.6T ZR/ZR+ pluggable and 2nm coherent DSPs with MACsec security for AI data center interconnects
key_facts.excerpt: Marvell... introduced 1.6T ZR/ZR+ pluggable and 2nm coherent DSPs with MACsec security for AI data center interconnects

key_facts.fact: Marvell stock surged over 15% in extended trading after the earnings beat
key_facts.excerpt: Marvell's stock soared more than 15% in extended trading, erasing a 3% loss it endured during the regular trading session

stories.headline: Seven tech giants sign White House pledge to fund all data center power and grid upgrades

key_facts.fact: Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Oracle, and xAI signed the Ratepayer Protection Pledge at the White House on March 4, committing to build, procure, or fund new generation capacity for their data centers
key_facts.excerpt: President Trump is calling on the leading United States hyperscalers and AI companies to build, bring, or buy all of the energy needed for building and operating data centers, paying the full cost of their energy and infrastructure

key_facts.fact: Companies committed to pay for all new power delivery infrastructure upgrades and to pay capacity rates whether or not they use the electricity, ensuring no costs are passed to residential ratepayers
key_facts.excerpt: Companies commit to pay these rates for the power and related infrastructure...whether they use the electricity or not

key_facts.fact: Signatories must hire from local communities, establish workforce development programs, and make their backup generation resources available to prevent blackouts
key_facts.excerpt: Signatories commit to hiring from within the local community and establishing programs to develop relevant skills... make available their backup generation resources...to prevent blackouts

key_facts.fact: The pledge is a voluntary, non-regulatory commitment described as a policy response to the strain AI infrastructure is placing on the U.S. electrical grid
key_facts.excerpt: The administration described the effort as a direct policy response to the strain that accelerating AI infrastructure build-out is placing on the U.S. grid

stories.headline: Alberta regulator rejects 1.4-gigawatt gas power plant for Canada's largest AI data center

key_facts.fact: The Alberta Utilities Commission rejected Synapse Real Estate Corp.'s application to build a 1.4-gigawatt natural gas-fired power plant in Olds, Alberta, citing 'significant deficiencies' in the application
key_facts.excerpt: The Alberta Utilities Commission (AUC) has rejected Synapse Real Estate Corp.'s application to construct a 1.4-gigawatt natural gas-fired power plant in the town of Olds, Alta., saying the application contained 'significant deficiencies'

key_facts.fact: The proposed plant would have powered what was planned to be Canada's largest AI data center complex in the town of Olds
key_facts.excerpt: Alberta regulator nixes power plant proposal for Canada's largest AI data centre complex

key_facts.fact: A local resident described the decision as a 'momentary sigh of collective relief' for the community which had opposed the project
key_facts.excerpt: 'Momentary sigh of collective relief,' says one Olds, Alta., resident

stories.headline: Xiaomi deploys humanoid robots in EV factory, achieving 90% success in 3-hour autonomous runs

key_facts.fact: Xiaomi deployed humanoid robots in its electric vehicle die-casting workshop, achieving 3 consecutive hours of autonomous operation at a self-tapping nut installation workstation with a 90.2% success rate
key_facts.excerpt: The humanoid worked at a self-tapping nut installation workstation in Xiaomi EV's die-casting workshop. It achieved a success rate of 90.2% by working for three consecutive hours

key_facts.fact: Xiaomi President Lu Weibing told CNBC that two humanoid robots can complete 90% of the work in three hours, keeping up with the factory's 76-second cycle time where a new car rolls off the line every 76 seconds
key_facts.excerpt: Two humanoid robots can complete 90% of the work in three hours... In Xiaomi's car factory, every 76 seconds, a new car gets off the assembly line. The two humanoid robots are able to keep up our pace

key_facts.fact: The robots use Xiaomi's 'Vision-Language-Action' AI model called Xiaomi-Robotics-0, integrating multimodal perception with reinforcement learning to adapt to tasks rather than following fixed scripts
key_facts.excerpt: These robots utilize a 'Vision-Language-Action' (VLA) AI model titled Xiaomi-Robotics-0. This system integrates multimodal perception—combining visual data and sensor feedback—with reinforcement learning

key_facts.fact: CEO Lei Jun announced plans to deploy 'a large number' of humanoid robots across Xiaomi factories within five years, with validation tests ongoing at other production stations
key_facts.excerpt: Xiaomi has tested self-developed humanoid robots for car production, as the company pushes forward with plans to deploy 'a large number' of self-developed humanoid robots in its own factories over the next five years

stories.headline: Agility Robotics rebrands to 'Agility' as Digit humanoid deployments expand to Toyota, Amazon

key_facts.fact: Agility Robotics announced its rebrand to Agility on March 5, dropping 'Robotics' from its name to signal expansion beyond hardware into software, services, and industrial automation infrastructure
key_facts.excerpt: Today, Agility Robotics announced its rebrand to Agility– marking a significant evolution in the company's identity as it advances the future of humanoid automation

key_facts.fact: The company remains on track to deliver a cooperatively safe humanoid robot in 2026, with Digit deployments expanding across customers including Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada, GXO, Schaeffler, and Amazon
key_facts.excerpt: Agility said it remains on track to deliver a cooperatively safe humanoid robot in 2026 as deployments of its Digit robot expand with customers including Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada, GXO, Schaeffler and Amazon

key_facts.fact: Chief Business Officer Daniel Diez said the rebrand signals readiness to 'scale beyond our current deployments and our ability to lead the adoption of humanoids across many new industries'
key_facts.excerpt: With our rebrand to Agility, we're signaling our readiness to scale beyond our current deployments and our ability to lead the adoption of humanoids across many new industries

key_facts.fact: Agility recently secured a major commercial agreement with Toyota and expanded its logistics footprint through a partnership with Mercado Libre in Latin America
key_facts.excerpt: Within the last few months, Agility has secured a major commercial agreement with Toyota and expanded its logistics footprint through a partnership with Mercado Libre

stories.headline: China's Noetix Robotics raises $140M Series B led by CATL unit for consumer humanoid robots

key_facts.fact: Noetix Robotics raised nearly RMB 1 billion (about $140 million) in a Series B round led by CD Capital, an industrial investment platform under CATL, with participation from CAS Investment, Jingguosheng Fund, and Unity Ventures
key_facts.excerpt: Noetix Robotics raised nearly 1 billion yuan (about $140 million) in a Series B round led by Chen Dao Capital, an investment platform under Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Ltd.

key_facts.fact: The funding will accelerate mass production and expansion into household consumer applications, bringing the company's total financing rounds to nine since inception
key_facts.excerpt: The new investment brings the Beijing-based company's total funding across nine rounds

key_facts.fact: Noetix pursues dual bipedal and bionic humanoid product lines, with its lower-cost 'Little Bumi' robot as an entry point for education and community deployments; the robot appeared on the CCTV Spring Festival Gala
key_facts.excerpt: Centered on a dual-drive technology roadmap of 'bipedal + bionic' systems, Noetix Robotics aims to drive the rapid penetration of embodied intelligence robots in the mass consumer market... 'Xiao Bumi' and 'Xiao Wantong N2' recently appeared on the CCTV Spring Festival Gala

key_facts.fact: The RMB 1 billion round matches the emerging baseline for embodied intelligence startups entering Series B, alongside peers LimX Dynamics, LinkerBot, GALAXEA, and AI² Robotics
key_facts.excerpt: Embodied robotics players like LimX Dynamics, LinkerBot, GALAXEA, and AI² Robotics all secured billion-yuan rounds in their Series B financings. That puts 1 billion yuan as the new baseline

stories.headline: NASA selects ULA's Centaur V as new SLS upper stage for Artemis IV and V missions

key_facts.fact: NASA officially selected ULA's Centaur V upper stage for the Space Launch System starting with Artemis IV, through a sole-source contract published March 6, replacing the cancelled Boeing Exploration Upper Stage
key_facts.excerpt: In a procurement filing published March 6, NASA determined that the Vulcan Centaur 5 upper stage is the only option to replace the Exploration Upper Stage

key_facts.fact: The contract covers upper stages for Artemis IV and V plus a flight spare; Blue Origin's New Glenn Upper Stage was assessed but disqualified on schedule and infrastructure grounds
key_facts.excerpt: The document assessed two candidates: ULA's Centaur V and Blue Origin's New Glenn Upper Stage. The NGUS was disqualified primarily on schedule and infrastructure grounds

key_facts.fact: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman announced on February 27 that the agency would standardize the SLS on a 'near Block 1' configuration, scrapping the Block 1B upgrade to reduce complexity and accelerate manufacturing
key_facts.excerpt: 'The idea is we want to reduce complexity to the greatest extent possible,' Isaacman said... 'We want to accelerate manufacturing'

key_facts.fact: The cancelled EUS would have cost nearly $2.8 billion through 2028 according to NASA's inspector general; the Centaur V is already flight-proven with four Vulcan launches since January 2024
key_facts.excerpt: The move could replace planned Boeing-built hardware, which NASA's inspector general has said will cost nearly $2.8 billion through 2028

key_facts.fact: Artemis IV is scheduled to launch no earlier than early 2028, when NASA aims to send humans to the Moon for the first time in over 50 years
key_facts.excerpt: NASA officially selected United Launch Alliance's Centaur 5 as the upper stage for its Space Launch System rocket starting with the Artemis 4 mission, scheduled to launch no earlier than early 2028

stories.headline: Spain's PLD Space raises $209M led by Mitsubishi Electric to scale Miura 5 rocket production

key_facts.fact: PLD Space raised €180 million ($209 million) in a Series C round, the largest funding round for a European space company announced in 2026, bringing total financing to over €350 million
key_facts.excerpt: PLD Space has raised 180 million euros ($209 million) to ramp up production of the Spanish startup's Miura 5 launch vehicle, marking the largest funding round for a European space business announced this year

key_facts.fact: The round was led by Japanese satellite maker Mitsubishi Electric, which secured priority access to the Miura 5 rocket for launch services supporting missions in the Asian market
key_facts.excerpt: The company said March 4 it had raised the funds in a Series C round led by Japanese satellite maker Mitsubishi Electric, which has partnered to secure priority access to the rocket

key_facts.fact: Miura 5 is slated for its first orbital flight attempt in 2026 from the Guiana Space Centre, with commercial services planned for 2027 and a target of 30 launches per year by 2030
key_facts.excerpt: Miura 5 is slated to fly for the first time this year in PLD Space's first attempt to reach orbit... with commercial services planned for 2027

key_facts.fact: PLD Space became the first private Spanish rocket company to launch when it flew the Miura 1 suborbital rocket in 2023, and is also developing the Miura Next medium-lift rocket with propulsive landing
key_facts.excerpt: The company was founded in 2011, becoming the first private Spanish rocket company. It debuted with the launch of the Miura 1 rocket in 2023 and has been developing a series of rockets, including the Miura 5

key_facts.fact: The funding comes as Europe ramps up independent space capabilities amid Trump's 'America First' policies and the war in Ukraine
key_facts.excerpt: It comes as U.S. President Donald Trump's 'America First' policies and the war in Ukraine have prompted Europe to ramp up its independent capabilities
